2.175.12
LinearScale.MaximumPin
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The LinearScale.MaximumPin element specifies the maximum value at which a LinearPointer on a
LinearScale stops. This element is optional. This element is of type ScalePin.
The following is the parent element of the LinearScale.MaximumPin element.
Parent elements
LinearScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the LinearScale.MaximumPin element.
 <xsd:element name="MaximumPin" type="ScalePinType" minOccurs="0" />
